Reviewers look at reports in the product and sometimes need a local copy of the report they are viewing.

## Problem
Reviewers want to take the rows of the report they are viewing away as a file, and every row on screen must still be in that file.
Example: a report with two rows should download as a file with the same two rows.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given a report containing two rows, when a reviewer downloads it, the downloaded file contains those same two rows.
